## Experience

**Assistant Professor**, Department of Genetics, Wrocław University of Environmental and Life Sciences\
*May 2026 – present · Wrocław, Poland*

- Research in bioinformatics and computational biology; teaching bioinformatics and biostatistics.

**Senior Bioinformatician**, 7N, contracted to a global pharmaceutical company\
*July 2019 – present · Warsaw, Poland*

- Processing and modelling of high-throughput drug response screens; co-author of the open-source gDR suite (Bioconductor).
- NGS data analysis: bulk and single-cell RNA-seq, whole-genome sequencing, 16S rRNA.
- Mass spectrometry phosphoproteomics.
- R/Shiny applications and production WDL pipelines; product owner role in an agile team.

**Founder and owner**, GeneStat\
*2019 – present · Wrocław, Poland*

- Bioinformatics and statistics services for research groups and companies: sequencing and spatial transcriptomics data analysis, statistical analysis of experiments, written reports.

**NGS data analysis internship**, Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics, Aarhus University\
*July – August 2018 · Foulum, Denmark*

**Statistical analysis internship**, Biostat sp. z o.o.\
*July – August 2016 · Rybnik, Poland*

## Software

- **ggwas**: ggplot2 plots for GWAS summary statistics (R; under review at Bioconductor). [github.com/bczech/ggwas](https://github.com/bczech/ggwas)
- **BRASSVis**: plots of gene fusions and structural variants from BRASS (R). [github.com/bczech/BRASSVis](https://github.com/bczech/BRASSVis)
- **gDR**: co-author of the R suite for drug response screens (Bioconductor). [github.com/gdrplatform](https://github.com/gdrplatform)

## Teaching

I teach bioinformatics and biostatistics at Wrocław University of Environmental and Life Sciences. Courses in 2026/27: Biostatistics; Data Analysis (machine learning in R and Python); Computer Lab (Unix command line for bioinformatics); Coding Lab for Erasmus+ students (in English). Materials: [bczech.github.io/teaching](https://bczech.github.io/teaching/).
